title: A worker's report carries attachments (screenshots, recordings, logs) to the reviewer and the operator; the review job can be given images
description:
Operator, 2026-10-01: verification know-how (how to capture and judge a UI) belongs in the ticks skill, written per tick by its author — agents will design better loops than anything we hard-code (ticks 20674131: Pattern: Work Someone Will See, DoR line). ticfac only provides the generic transport the skill cannot, with no UI-specific concept:
1. Attachments: a worker can attach files to its report (images, recordings, logs) by a declared convention (e.g. a manifest in the report or an attachments dir the report names); the executor collects them for every executor (local, herdr, cloud), stores them (local run dir / factory R2), size-bounded, kept OUT of the integration tree (like RESULT-*.md since #169), and shows/links them from ticfac watch/status/events and the epic PR.
2. Images to the review job: the final review (and any role job the profile marks) is given the attempt's image attachments when its model accepts images; otherwise it is told they exist and where.
3. A vision-capable model is reachable through the role/tier config like any other; in the cloud a Workers AI vision model via the gateway (never claude in the cloud).
The report linter accepts and validates the attachment manifest (paths exist, types, size cap).
acceptance_criteria: [1] A local and a cloud worker each attach a PNG to a report; the run records it, the PR body links it, and it never lands on the integration branch. [2] A review job on an image-capable model receives the attachment; on a text-only model it is told the path. [3] make gate + cloudflare tests pass.
